title: Complex to Real-Imag
text: Output real and imaginary parts of complex input signal, 1 input, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Output} sets Real and/or; {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the interval between samples. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Output
params.values: Real and/or imaginary output specification Real and imag (default) | Real | Imag
